dataset.name: Committee master file
dataset.description: Registration attributes for FEC committees, including raw designation, type, organization type, connected-organization name, and candidate reference fields.

acquisition.pagination: None. Each requested two-year period is one complete ZIP snapshot.

partitions.name: two_year_period
partitions.source: Requested bulk URL path; cycle_suffix is the period's final two digits.
partitions.purpose: Snapshot acquisition, replay, and downstream assertion scope; the source record has no reporting-period column.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries for transport failures; follow redirects; publish only after validating the HTTP result, ZIP integrity, exact member name, archive digest, row width, and record count.

physical_schema.line_ending: LF with a required final LF in the verified 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026 artifacts
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: An empty physical line becomes an explicit record-boundary issue; it is never silently skipped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve every empty source field as the empty string. Absence of ORG_TP, CONNECTED_ORG_NM, party, or CAND_ID is not a negative assertion.

identity.occurrence_locator: archive SHA-256 + exact member name + one-based physical line number
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + SHA-256 of the exact source line
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every physical occurrence. Conflicting values for one committee and snapshot block any singleton committee projection.

time_fields.meaning: The requested FEC bulk snapshot period. The committee record itself contains no transaction or effective date.

code_fields.meaning: Raw organization type code; an empty value stays unknown.

rules: Do not derive graph identity from committee name, connected-organization name, address, or treasurer.
Keep CONNECTED_ORG_NM as a source assertion, not a resolved corporation edge.
Keep CAND_ID as a source field; candidate-to-committee relationship facts come from the linkage file with their own provenance.
Do not classify a terminal funding source from one code or name substring during source normalization.
Preserve source values before code interpretation, entity resolution, or committee classification.

revisions.publisher_model: The FEC replaces each two-year committee archive with a current snapshot and publishes no row-level revision identifier in this file.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Retain immutable acquired snapshots; a current committee profile must identify the selected snapshot and surface conflicts.

checks.rule: The archive digest, requested period, exact cm.txt member, retrieval time, and response metadata are present.
Every physical line has exactly 15 fields; short rows are not padded and extra fields are not truncated.
Every source byte decodes under the accepted encoding; invalid bytes are retained as failed raw evidence, never silently dropped.
Every non-empty physical line becomes one record occurrence or one explicit issue.
Conflicting records for one CMTE_ID and source period remain separate and block a singleton projection.
Member name, field order, or field count changes require contract review.

use.retention: Retain the exact archive, HTTP metadata, archive digest, member inventory, record occurrences, and issues indefinitely; derived profiles and graph assertions are rebuildable.
use.disclaimer: Committee master fields are registration assertions from a captured FEC snapshot. Names, codes, and connected-organization text do not alone prove control, beneficial ownership, or money flow.
